text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way to the school building with 
Meisho Doto, we heard King Halo's voice.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! When one speaks of a first-class 
Umamusume, they mean me!!

text_block_list.name: Entourage
text_block_list.text: King Halo!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hawawa... It's the rumored King Call, yes 
it is...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
K-King-san looks so dignified too— She's 
so... d-dazzling, isn't she...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Good day, Doto-san. Thank you for the 
passionate gaze you've been sending my 
way.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyowaaa~~~?! S-Sorry! I didn't mean to 
p-p-peeeek...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It's alright, I understand even if you 
don't say it.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You want to praise me with a 'King Call' 
too, don't you!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyowa! N-N-No, someone like me...!? I 
don't have the confidence, there's no way 
I can do ittt...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Worry not! I grant you the 
privilege of being taught directly by 
King!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
K-King-san, you're going to teach me? 
Someone like me... Awawawa...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While Meisho Doto stood bewildered, 
practice for the King Call began—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: My name is?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It's "King!" The key is to say it crisp 
and sharp.

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Close! It's 'King!' Let's say it nice and 
clear~♪"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
*waaaah*~, I'm so sorry~...! I-I just 
can't bring myself to drop the 
honorifics~!
choice_data_list: This might be your weak spot...
That might not be your strong suit...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Then here's your chance to overcome it! 
Come on, keep trying until you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-But... I c-c-can't take up any more of 
your precious time, King-saaaan...!

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"It's totally fine~. None of the three of 
us have plans, so don't worry about it at 
all~."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I couldn't possibly...! Um, I'll go back 
and practice on my own...! I'm 
so-s-s-sorryyy!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Solo practice? You're...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, um...! I'm sorry, I'm so 
sorryyy~~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to pull it off perfectly... I 
thought if I could succeed... maybe I'd 
gain a little confidence, like King... 
*sniff*

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I like your guts. We're going to 
keep going until that King Call is a total 
success!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Gasp... A-Are you sure... is it really 
okay...!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, ah, King-san, I... I-I'll do my 
abso-loot bestest~~!!
choice_data_list: First, how about we take a break?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Al-al-alright! I-I'm gonna do this~~~~...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Let's try it together with 
these girls! With both of them here, 
dropping the honorifics should be much 
easier, right?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto continued her training. The 
special practice lasted until dusk—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I'll go buy us some drinks then...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry~~! I left my wallet 
behind...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You've got quite a few careless mistakes, 
too... Very well, I'll teach you 
everything from top to bottom!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After getting plenty of rest, I received 
rigorous instruction from King Halo. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Kaaah!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A shining star of hoooope~~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ayyy!

text_block_list.name: Entourage
text_block_list.text: Beyond first-rate—truly top-tier♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: N-n-noooo!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A skilled hawk doesn't hide its talons!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: G (staaaaare)!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text:
The greatest Umamusume of all! Kiiing... 
Halooo!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
O-ho-ho-ho-ho-ho! Not bad, mastering the 
New King Call and all!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, u-um... Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto successfully pulled off the 
New King Call that was born during 
practice.
